title: PTY release: 50 terminal tabs closed at once give their PTYs back within 1 s (count of /dev/ptmx before, at once, 0.25-10 s after)
why: Lead 2026-11-03 00:4xZ: L6 at 120/s ran the host out of PTYs ('PTY capacity exhausted', STATUS 7860); a closed tab that keeps its PTY would be a daemon leak.
